message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "enforce_cxr_tool_invocation", "description": "When interpreting chest imaging data, the agent must invoke designated CXR analysis tools rather than attempting direct visual interpretation or hallucinating findings from non-CXR modalities.", "applicable_conditions": "The task involves medical imaging interpretation where Chest X-Ray (CXR) images are provided or implied as the primary diagnostic source, and the agent has access to specific CXR processing tools.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the input contains chest imaging data (specifically CXRs) or the user requests an interpretation of chest images: (1) Do NOT attempt to describe findings based on internal knowledge or hallucinated observations; (2) Immediately invoke `chest_xray_classifier` to identify abnormalities or `chest_xray_report_generator` to produce a structured report; (3) Base all subsequent clinical reasoning strictly on the output returned by these tools."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
